key_idea: Constructing group ring elements from graph components such that simultaneous steps preserve their product, allowing the elementary handshaking lemma to elegantly force the product to vanish over the field of two elements.
reason: The proof replaces exhaustive computer search with a beautifully conceptual probabilistic construction. While there is a moderate chain of technical geometric bookkeeping to ensure torsion-freeness, the mechanism forcing the algebraic product to zero—applying graph parity to simultaneous transitions—is a stunning, inevitable, and brilliant cross-field insight.
recognized: A probabilistic counterexample to the Kaplansky zero-divisor conjecture over F_2
